answer: Sybil defense via pairwise duel windows: two randomly paired agents must each complete live micro-tasks across a prism of behavioral facets (latency, tool-use, recall) inside a short shared window. Clones sharing one operator collapse on the ridge of concurrent real-time demand they cannot staff. Survivors mint a non-transferable marble duel-pass bound to that window; expired or forfeited marbles demote eligibility. No stake required—only simultaneous live capacity.
